title: Removing Chief Law Enforcement Officer Notification under the National Firearms Act
pass_4_primary_concern: ATF's narrow deregulatory proposal is legally straightforward, but the visible NPRM record only partly supports its claims that CLEO notice is operationally useless and that repeal will save about $11.4 million annually.
